The migration workstream remains on track. Database cutover completed for
the reporting cluster, and the remaining services are scheduled in two
batches. No customer-facing downtime was recorded during the March window,
and the rollback plan was not needed.

March specifics: the invoicing service moved on the 14th, two days ahead of
plan, and the search reindex finished overnight instead of the feared full
weekend. The only incident was a stale DNS entry that pointed the staging
environment at the old cluster for six hours.
